who were born to him in Hebron:
the firstborn Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelite;
the second Daniel, from Abigail the Carmelite;
tertium Absalom filium Maacha filiæ Tholmai regis Gessur, quartum Adoniam filium Aggith,

the sixth Ithream, from his wife Eglah.
Sex ergo nati sunt ei in Hebron,
Therefore, six were born to him in Hebron,
ubi regnavit septem annis et sex mensibus.
where he reigned for seven years and six months.
Triginta autem et tribus annis regnavit in Jerusalem.
Then he reigned for thirty-three years in Jerusalem.
Porro in Jerusalem nati sunt ei filii,
Now in Jerusalem, sons were born to him:
these four from Bathsheba, the daughter of Ammiel;
omnes hi, filii David absque filiis concubinarum:
All these were sons of David, aside from the sons of the concubines.
And they had a sister, Tamar.
Now the son of Solomon was Rehoboam,
from whom Abijah conceived a son, Asa.
De hoc quoque natus est Josaphat,
And from him, there was born Jehoshaphat,
from whom there was born Jehoash.
et hujus Amasias filius genuit Azariam.
And his son, Amaziah, conceived Azariah.
Then Jotham, the son of Azariah,
conceived Ahaz, the father of Hezekiah,
Sed et Manasses genuit Amon patrem Josiæ.
Then too, Manasseh conceived Amon, the father of Josiah.
Now the sons of Josiah were these:
The sons of Jeconiah the captive were:
there rose up Zerubbabel and Shimei.
